objective: Batch independent discussion points while preserving per-point proposals, implications, partial responses, and evaluation of user-added solutions.
assumptions: AWG decision authority remains per point
Coupled points are not silently batched
The session is offline and provider-neutral
unknowns: Future renderers may use list or tree navigation
invariants: Each point has at least two proposals and an implication helper
Each point has independent response identity
A user-added proposal is evaluated before selection
Partial responses do not authorize unanswered points
Coupled points are excluded or explicitly related
acceptance_predicates: Omitted proposals, cross-point authorization, unevaluated additions, and unbatched query traces fail
